verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing claims it can "capture receipts" alongside real-time expense categorization and accounting sync, so it has a first-party receipt capability. Nothing documents automatic matching of receipts to the right transaction, and nothing documents email submission. Bill upload (relay-docs-4) is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, email-forwarding receipt submission, a documented upload flow, how-to support docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
